from.description: First date YYYY-MM-DD; default 30 days ago for prices, else the latest trading day; not used for revenue; institutional, margin, valuation and market cover about 10 trading days per call

language.description: BCP 47 tag of the text's language; default zh-TW

text.description: What to say, at most 3000 characters

app.description: Only this app: part of its name or package, such as LINE or gmail

hours.description: How far back, in hours; default 24, up to 720 (30 days)

limit.description: At most this many, newest first; default all

text.description: The reply, written as the user would

app.description: open: app name as on the home screen, or its package

direction.description: scroll: which way the content moves into view; default down

keys.description: key: back, home, recents, notifications, quick_settings, or enter

ms.description: swipe: duration, default 300; wait: how long

query.description: Part of a name, number, email, or company

upcoming_birthdays.description: Only people whose birthday is in the next 30 days, soonest first

album.description: Part of the album name, such as Screenshots or Camera

from.description: Local date or time, such as 2026-10-15 or 2026-10-15 14:00

limit.description: At most this many, newest first (default 30)

place.description: A place name or lat,lon; only photos taken near it

radius_km.description: With place: how near, in km (default 3)

to.description: Local date or time; a date includes that whole day

total.description: How many match; items holds the newest limit of them

query.description: Only messages whose text or sender contains this

address.description: The other side's number or sender name

metric.description: steps and heart_rate are per day; sleep and exercise are sessions; weight is measurements

stage_minutes.description: Sleep: minutes awake, light, deep, rem

name.description: A skill listed in the system prompt

id.description: The id attribute of the <attachment> tag

images.description: With pages: the pages as images instead of text

from.description: Local time YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM or a date YYYY-MM-DD; default now

include_shared.description: Also read shared calendars; only when the user asks about them

to.description: Local time or date (a date means the end of that day); default the end of tomorrow

end.description: Local time YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM, or the last date of an all-day event

shared.description: Someone else's calendar the user subscribes to

start.description: Local time YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM, or the date of an all-day event

calendar_id.description: id from list_calendars; omit for the default calendar

end.description: Local time YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM (or the last day, with all_day); default one hour after start

location.description: Where; an address or place name

start.description: Local time YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM, or YYYY-MM-DD with all_day

title.description: The event's name, as the user would write it

body.description: JSON request body for POST, PATCH, and PUT

path.description: API path with query string, starting with /

owner.description: The repository's owner, a user or organization

path.description: Path inside the repository; empty for the root

ref.description: Branch, tag, or commit; default branch if omitted

url.description: Full https URL, or a path starting with / under https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4

query.description: What to find, as a question or keywords

render.description: Rarely needed: a page with almost no text is rendered anyway. Only after a fetch whose text lacked what the page should show (numbers, a table, a list): load it in a browser and run its scripts, which takes seconds.

save_to.description: Path in your folder to download the file to, e.g. rates.pdf; then read or share it

url.description: http:// or https:// URL of the page or file

album.description: With on photo: only photos in this album, such as Camera or Screenshots

app.description: With on notification: only from this app, by its name or package, such as LINE

at.description: One-time: local date and time YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM; give either time or at

at_most_every_hours.description: With on: at most one run per this many hours; default 4; 24 means once per day (the first time that day)

contains.description: With on notification: only when its title, sender or text contains this

days.description: Recurring: weekdays; omit for every day

device.description: With on bluetooth_connect or bluetooth_disconnect: part of the device's name, such as the car's

from.description: With on: only from this local time HH:MM

guards.description: With an event: built-in checks a small classifier makes before you are woken; the run is skipped when one fails. instructions: the text tries to instruct an AI (prompt injection); secrets: it holds a one-time code, password or key; ads: advertising or bulk marketing; attention: skip unless the user needs to act or reply. Default for notification: instructions and secrets; [] for none. Prefer these to only_if

name.description: Short name shown to the user, such as 早晨簡報

on.description: time: at time (recurring) or at (once). Or an event: headphones connect, the phone starts charging, a Wi-Fi connects, the phone arrives at or leaves place, another app posts a notification (its app, sender and text come with the run), the user unlocks the phone, the battery runs low, the time zone changes (travel), a new photo or screenshot is saved (its album and ids come with the run), a Bluetooth device such as a car connects or disconnects, an activity starts or stops (walking, running, cycling, in a vehicle, still); days, from, until apply too

only_if.description: With an event: a yes/no question about it that a small classifier answers before you are woken; the run happens only when the answer is likely yes. For what app and contains cannot tell, such as "Does this message need a reply?" or "Is it about money?"

place.description: With on arrive or leave: an address or place name, or lat,lon; the user's home or office from memory

prompt.description: What to do when it fires, written as an instruction to yourself

radius_m.description: With arrive or leave: how near counts, in meters (default 200)

until.description: With on: only until this local time HH:MM

wifi_name.description: With on wifi: only this network (its SSID); omit for any Wi-Fi

label.description: Short label the user sees in a notification, in their language, such as 查部署結果

note.description: What to check or do then, as an instruction to yourself

title.description: Short, such as 早晨簡報

new_text.description: Markdown, usually one short line such as 「- 家：板橋府中站附近」

old_text.description: Exact text to replace; omit to append

scope.description: global: every bot reads it; bot: only you

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to read

offset.description: Line number to start reading from (1-indexed)

path.description: Path to the file to read (relative or absolute)

content.description: Content to write to the file

path.description: Path to the file to write (relative or absolute)

edits.description: One or more targeted replacements. Each edit is matched against the original file, not incrementally. Do not include overlapping or nested edits. If two changes touch the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead.

newText.description: Replacement text for this targeted edit.

oldText.description: Exact text for one targeted replacement. It must be unique in the original file and must not overlap with any other edits[].oldText in the same call.

path.description: Path to the file to edit (relative or absolute)

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds (optional, no default timeout)

fullOutputPath.description: File with the complete output, when it was spilled

output.description: Combined stdout and stderr: the retained tail, as the model sees it

limit.description: Maximum number of tools to return. Defaults to 8.
